notes.title: Demons Mode Bugfix
notes.notes:
You now unlock Demons Mode at Legendary Gold Rank, as was intended! I apologise for the bug.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/923da02e08b52df91830edce91b38212292b5d6e.png[/img]

Special thanks for making me aware of this bug goes to [b]2b2v[/b], who currently holds the highest score on multiple leader boards! Be sure to check out their twitch stream: https://www.twitch.tv/2b2v

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/1c691e8ff2eeee3614e0ba18224a355f75afbfc2.png[/img]

notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Two new abilities are in this update!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/b62c74e9a9f286802283bea65c5326eeadc10f7a.png[/img]
Pulse
Can't be bothered stabbing them all after you dodge them? This ability is for you! It kills all of them, and pulls all the batteries to you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/8f04ae0d4d1b42d71f72d61e3a081ed432f86b9e.png[/img]
Grapple
Throw a grappling hook that hooks you on to spawners, and pulls you to them. This one's very tricky to master, but you could become a bit of a Stabby Ninja!

Enjoy!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/1c691e8ff2eeee3614e0ba18224a355f75afbfc2.png[/img]

notes.title: Cosmetics Update
notes.notes:
The [u][b]price will double[/b][/u] in the next update! This game will leave early access, with two new abilities implemented.

In the current update:

[list]
    [*]New Achievements
    [*]Cosmetics section in the shop, containing:
    [*]Talon prints!
    [*]A top hat!
    [*]Dual wielding swords!
    [*]An awesome cape!
    [*]Dark trails for your sword!
    [*]The mysterious [u]cycling hues[/u] cosmetic!
[/list]

notes.title: Abilities Update
notes.notes:
Features:

[list]
    [*]Complete quests and kill bosses/demons to earn Stabby Coins!
    [*]Two abilities to purchase using Stabby Coins:
    [*]Sprint 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/950b6ab98aabc23a5e9725bd436bec1f3b4dcd5f.png[/img]
    [*]Ghost 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/aba7012502f3c652ac52bc0352641250f80e82a6.png[/img]
[/list]

Each boss/demon drops 50 more coins than the last, so survive for longer to earn huge amounts! (the first boss drops 50)

notes.title: Demons Update
notes.notes:
The Demons Update is now live!

[list]
    [*]Custom key bindings
    [*]New reward screen for when you beat your high score - NOW CONTAINS FIREWORKS
    [*]Demons game mode (demons are very dangerous)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/923da02e08b52df91830edce91b38212292b5d6e.png[/img]


The next update will contain [b]two abilities[/b] to buy in the shop! Release is estimated to be next week.
